If you're working in a different directory, share the path and I'll run the rename. Otherwise, the fastest approach when files do exist is:

```powershell
# Dry-run first
Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File | Select-String -Pattern "AccountService" | Select-Object Path -Unique

# Then rename content in all files
Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File | ForEach-Object {
```
